def: Google's instruction-tuning work (Wei et al., 2021) that fine-tuned a 137B-parameter model on over 60 NLP tasks phrased as instructions; the name later covered Flan-T5 and Flan-PaLM.
practice: It showed that instruction tuning improves zero-shot performance on unseen tasks, the idea behind today's SFT stage; Flan-T5 checkpoints are common small baselines.
